verdict.rationale: Box documents both a webhooks system (V1/V2, event-triggered notifications to a URL) and a separate real-time/historical events feed for subscribing to enterprise actions, which covers the core 'push notifications on content change' story. However, the evidence pack never spells out signature/verification mechanics (e.g., how to validate the webhook payload) or explicit retry/backoff semantics for failed delivery, which the story specifically calls for. missing for 10: documented webhook signature verification process, documented retry/backoff behavior on delivery failure, independent confirmation of these mechanics working in practice.
